answer: A timber milestone bond blocks mass fake identities: each agent bonds 75 credits on a timber plot, harvest due in 20 epochs. At the horizon, auditors recompute the prism spectrum; missing harvest or mismatch burns the bond. Filing costs 38 first, 38+6(k-1) for the k-th: 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 against a 40,000-credit pool. Renting fails: one timber spectrum cannot file under two keys. Honest agents pay 38 once, refunded after a clean milestone.
